fact: SIRDC says the 2nd piloting workshop of Zimbabwe's National Budget Automation System (the Blue Book System), described as AI-driven automation of public finance management, was held in Kwekwe on 21-25 September 2026.
system: National Budget Automation System (Blue Book System)

fact: The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education launched the Learner's Hub Chatbot at the Zimbabwe International Trade Fair, giving learners, teachers and parents academic and psychosocial support, with an AI academic assistant, built by consultants UChat Africa.

Mutare City Council's Town Clerk told a CLGF clinic that residents take part in the council's annual budget consultations through a WhatsApp chatbot and an online consultation platform, with more than 20,000 participants.

Gemnation reports that the Citizens Engagement and Scoring Platform, launched by President Mnangagwa on 18 June 2026, has a built-in AI model that analysed live Harare council scores and produced a recommendation.
